s1.text:
The corridor stretches ahead, lit by flickering torches that cast long shadows across the stone walls. A low hum vibrates through the floor — the arena's heartbeat, waiting.

Two paths branch before you. To the left, a narrow passage carved with ancient runes that pulse faintly. To the right, the main gate stands ajar, warm light spilling through the crack.
s1.ascensionText: You've been here before. The torches flicker the same way, the hum through the floor is familiar — but the shadows feel heavier now, like they remember you too.
s1.imagePrompt: A dark stone corridor splitting into two paths, ancient runes glowing faintly on left wall, warm light through a gate on the right, dramatic torchlight, dark fantasy

choices.text: Follow the runes — they might reveal something useful
Push through the main gate — no time for detours
You recognize this gate — your training covered siege entries

s2a.text:
The runes tell a story — a pattern of combat. Strike, then guard, then strike again. The rhythm of the Gatekeeper's fighting style, etched into the wall by those who came before.

You memorize the sequence. Knowledge is the sharpest weapon.
s2a.imagePrompt: Glowing blue runes on a dark stone wall depicting combat patterns, a hand reaching toward them, mystical atmosphere, dark fantasy

choices.text: Study them deeper before moving on

s2b.text:
The gate groans open. Beyond it, a training yard — scarred dummies, broken weapons, old bloodstains. This is where the Gatekeeper drills.

A rack of practice weapons lines one wall. Heavy, crude, but real.
s2b.imagePrompt: A dark training yard with scarred wooden dummies and broken weapons scattered on the ground, weapon rack on wall, moody torchlight, dark fantasy

choices.text: Grab a heavy practice sword and warm up
Study the damage patterns on the dummies
Smash through the reinforced dummy — prove you're stronger than his training gear

s2c.text:
You press your back against the cold stone and wait. Footsteps echo from the arena above — heavy, deliberate. A pattern emerges: three steps, pause, three steps.

The Gatekeeper paces. Predictable. That's something you can use.
s2c.imagePrompt: A figure pressed against a dark stone wall in shadow, listening, faint light from above, tension, dark fantasy atmosphere

choices.text: Move when the footsteps pause — slip in unnoticed
Steel yourself and walk in with confidence

s3_final.text:
The arena doors loom before you. Beyond them, the Gatekeeper waits — the first test every challenger must face.

You feel ready. Whatever you learned in these corridors, it's part of you now.
s3_final.ascensionText: The Gatekeeper is already facing the entrance when the doors open. His eyes narrow. "You again," he growls. "This time I won't hold back."
s3_final.imagePrompt: Massive arena doors partially open with light streaming through, a silhouette of a warrior standing ready, epic dark fantasy, dramatic lighting
